title: Cookie policy · HousySpace
description: HousySpace cookie policy: which cookies the website uses and how to manage your preferences.

items.text: **Machine translation, pending lawyer review.** Translated from the approved Spanish text.

A cookie is a small file that a website stores on your device when you visit it. Other similar technologies, such as the browser's local or session storage, work in a similar way. They are used so that the website works, remembers your preferences or measures how it is used.

**HousySpace Consultores Inmobiliarios, S.L.**, CIF B26903419. Travessera de Gràcia 73, 2º-3ª, 08006 Barcelona. Email: [info@housyspace.com](mailto:info@housyspace.com). More details in the [legal notice](route:legal).
**Own cookies: none.** The HousySpace website does not install cookies on your device.

**Technical session storage.** We use the browser's session storage to remember whether you have opened the menu (“hs_menu”) and to avoid repeating the entry animation during your visit (“hs_intro”). It contains no personal data and is deleted when you close the tab. It is necessary for the website to work as you expect, so it does not require your consent (Article 22.2 of the LSSI).
**No analytics or advertising.** This website does not use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies.
4. Third-party services loaded on the website

Some features are provided with services from other companies. When they are loaded, those companies receive your IP address and basic data about your browser and, depending on the service, may install cookies or use local storage. HousySpace does not install or control those cookies. Each company processes them according to its own policy.

items.text: 5. How to disable or delete cookies

You can allow, block or delete cookies from your browser's privacy settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge or another). If you block cookies from third-party services, the maps or the valuator may not work. The Spanish Data Protection Agency explains how to do it at [www.aepd.es](https://www.aepd.es).

If in the future we use analytics, advertising or other non-necessary cookies, we will update this policy and ask for your consent before installing them. You will be able to accept or reject them, and change your mind whenever you want.
To find out how we process your personal data, see the [privacy policy](route:privacy). If you have any questions about this policy, write to us at [info@housyspace.com](mailto:info@housyspace.com).
